component.name: Audeze Overlay
component.summary: Headset status and controls over your game

description.p: A small native overlay for Audeze Maxwell headsets. It talks to the USB dongle directly, shows the game/chat mix, noise cancellation, sidetone and battery while you play, and changes them with the headset's controls. The Audeze app does not need to run.
The overlay needs a Wayland compositor with the layer-shell protocol, such as KDE Plasma, Sway, Hyprland, niri or COSMIC. GNOME's compositor does not offer it.
This is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with Audeze.
